title: announce
description: Topic {prefix}/{robot_id}/announce, ROS to HA, QoS 1, retained, no expiry. Identity plus the task catalogue and, since 0.2.0, an optional joints block describing the joint telemetry published on {prefix}/{robot_id}/joints. An empty retained payload is a tombstone and is not a JSON document. Republished on connect, on HA birth and on catalogue change. Size limit 64 KiB.

name.description: Human-readable robot name shown as the HA device name.

executor.description: Name and version of the loaded executor plugin.

hmac_required.description: True when the node has a shared secret configured and rejects unsigned commands.

heartbeat_interval_s.description: Interval of the robot heartbeat in seconds. 0 means the node sends no heartbeat and HA does no staleness tracking.

tasks.description: The task catalogue after the operator's tasks.allow intersection. A task with no required params gets a button in HA; every task is callable through send_task.

joints.description: Optional (added 2026-10-14, 0.2.0). Describes the joint telemetry the node publishes on {prefix}/{robot_id}/joints. Absent when the executor reports no joints or telemetry.joints_rate_hz is 0; HA then creates no joint sensors and removes any it made from an earlier announce.

label.description: Human-readable label used for buttons and speech.

timeout_s.description: Default task timeout in seconds; a command may override it within the node's cap.

params.description: null when the task takes no parameters, otherwise a params_subset schema.

names.description: The joint names in publication order; positions on the joints topic follow this order. One to 32 names.

limits.description: null when the executor knows no limits, otherwise one [minimum, maximum] pair per name in the announced unit.

rate_hz.description: The node's maximum publish rate on the joints topic in messages per second (telemetry.joints_rate_hz, default 2). Greater than 0; a node with the rate set to 0 omits the whole joints block.
